frontmatter.name: atomic-flow-redesign
frontmatter.overview: Redesign Silver Bullet as an Agentic Process Orchestrator (APO): Process > Workflows > Atomic Flows > Flow Steps/Skills, with each atomic flow executed as one subagent work package and protected by its own V-model verification loop. Distill software engineering and DevOps into a minimal non-redundant set of meaningful atomic flows and reusable flow steps, then express shipped, team-custom, and dynamic workflows as hierarchical, maximally parallelizable composition over that catalog.

todos.content: Define the declarative APO schema for processes, workflows, atomic flows, flow steps, artifacts, V-loops, tools, and dynamic composition rules.
Inventory every skill, workflow, runtime token, worker template, and absorbed dependency capability into a distillation table.
Design and write the minimal non-redundant atomic flow catalog with stable IDs, hierarchy rules, and migration mapping from FLOW 1–18.
Recompose all pre-composed, specialized, and arbitrary workflow surfaces using only canonical atomic flow IDs and reusable workflow references.
Add user-intent ledger, artifact/evidence registry, and V-loop rollup semantics for composed workflows.
Add team process pack model for custom process composition over SB atomic flows.
Align orchestrator queues, workflow chain guards, worker templates, and workflow logs with the new catalog.
Clean or remove redundant public skill commands where breaking cleanup improves the model.
Update docs/site/distribution surfaces and add drift tests that enforce catalog, composer, and runtime alignment.
Run full verification, sync plugin outputs, and prepare release notes for the breaking architectural refactor.
